<!-- pr-reviewer: 5081fd8f62523f26a3fdba262ef6f41f110ee56e -->
Clean safety-tier review. No changes are required before merge. This feature waits for the next minor cut.

The trial merge with upstream main `ad0307b7a949adf5629daaf61b8e326bb4de0fe0` succeeded. All builds and tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3231`. No GitHub runner was used. I checked the laws against that main revision.

The release and installation checks refuse unsupported inputs. The app tests cover project reopening and preservation of an existing NC file. I checked every line of the new NC golden and all eleven refusal goldens. The blank coordinates, arc centres, directions, feeds, preset, stops, and tool-change sequence agree with the fixture and the cited controller manual.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 386 steps; 3,010 tests passed; 7 ignored |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | PASS: 200 steps; 43 tests passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |

The heavy gate also verified four marked expected failures for #2849 and #1950. They failed at the pinned assertions as required. They are not new failures in this PR.

Heavy lanes with executed passing tests: `app heavy: adaptive_fig8_crossing`, `app heavy: adaptive_pinch`, `app heavy: operations`, `app heavy: pick_agnostic`, `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`, `app heavy: rotary_field_parity`, `app heavy: shared_face_bodies_finish`, `app heavy: shoulder_adaptive`, `app heavy: stock_engine_agreement`, `app heavy: stock_field_cost`, `app heavy: stock_play_precalc`, `app heavy: carried_engine_agreement`, `app heavy: verify`, `app heavy: whole_model_pocket`, `app heavy: example_catalog`, `app heavy: feature_pick_wire`, `app heavy: import_solidcraft`, `app heavy: large_models`, `app heavy: lathe_field_sim`, `app heavy: lathe_workholding_kinds`.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_heidenhain_klartext`: 23 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test comment_escape`: 4 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test recorded_streams`: 12 passed.

These suites read the new fixture or the affected golden directories. I ran them again after the quick gate. The diff changes no import code or STEP fixture. The extra importer suites do not apply. The app crate has no light-lane twins.

Mutations repeated through the standalone CLI:

1. Change `340490-03` to `340490-04`. RED: the CLI refused the controller profile and preserved the existing output. GREEN: restore the release; the CLI wrote a complete program.
2. Add `WorkOffset 7` after valid `WorkOffset 2`. RED: the CLI refused the offset and preserved the existing output. GREEN: restore the stream; the CLI wrote a complete program.

Requested before merge: none.

The PR changes no UI code, build scripts, workflows, or dependencies. The physical Picomax checks listed in the PR remain pending. These local results do not qualify the physical machine or a different controller release.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Coordinator: this PR merges by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-21 ("merge using the recommended option"). The review that this merge relies on is the collaborator `pr-reviewer` marker on head 5081fd8f6 (clean). The head has no commits after that review, and the PR merges cleanly with `main`. I merge it on head 5081fd8f6. It is a fork PR, so its branch stays.
